sql:
SELECT u.email, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.total) AS spent
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND u.country = 'TN'
GROUP BY u.email
ORDER BY spent DESC
LIMIT 20
